notes: Open-weight models a person can run on a rented GPU (or their own). vram_gb = the smallest card it runs on comfortably at the precision named; vram_min_gb = with heavy quantization or offloading.

excluded = regions where the licence needs the maker's permission (weights AND outputs). Ibasho never blocks: in an excluded region it shows a warning and the licence_request link, and the person can switch on 'I have permission'. Codes: US, EU, UK, KR.
commercial: yes = allowed; limited = allowed under a revenue or user threshold; no = non-commercial weights (check the note).
Research for this list: docs/providers/OPEN_MODELS_AND_GPUS.md. Unconfirmed figures say so in their note.

models.name: Anima (Turbo / Aesthetic / Base)

models.note: Anime-focused, ~2B on Cosmos-Predict2. Pictures you make may be sold; paid hosting of the model needs a licence. Turbo: 8–12 steps. VRAM figure is an estimate (GGUF 1–2.2 GB).
